name: Sanbiki no Mesu Buta ~Kangoku no Oshiro~
original_name: 三美姫の牝豚 ～姦獄の城～
source:
The peace that seemed to last forever was shattered in an instant! The three allied kingdoms of Brattenhardt, Duchâteau, and Flores collapsed due to a surprise invasion by the evil Altercian Empire, which boasted the greatest military power at that time! The princesses of the three kingdoms, Aries, Charlene, and Mireia, and the rest of the royal family are taken prisoner!

Felix, the imperial officer in command of the military invasion operation, has thoroughly discouraged the inhabitants of the invaded lands from revolting. He is ordered by the emperor to “defile” the princesses, the symbols of the kingdom, in order to discourage them from revolting and to make them swear absolute loyalty to the empire!

Felix and the other Imperial soldiers who are skilled in the art of degrading women, those who have betrayed the Kingdom to the Imperial side, and those who have developed personal grudges against the Empire, all have their evil hands on Aries and her friends!

The noble Princess Aries is subjected to a series of humiliations and national crimes that trample on her pride as a princess and her patriotic feelings! For the selfish Princess Charlene, we will beat her rebellious nature back with a hard punishment, no questions asked! For the innocent and merciful Princess Mireia, we defile her voluptuous body and instill in her the immoral pleasure of betraying the one she loves!

They have become an outlet for their desires, and are now in a whorish frenzy with their three different princesses! Their innocence, which should be absolutely inviolable, is cruelly shattered, and their innocence, honor, pride, and dignity as human beings are played with in a parade of sexual development!

Soon, the only thing that comes out of their mouths, which they say for the sake of their people, their friends, and their families, is a gasp mixed with lewd words, as they flirt with their hated enemies for the sake of their own pleasure!

The figure is that of an animal that abandons reason and lives by its reproductive instincts... Yes, it is a female pig!

[From [url=http://www.ordin-soft.com/sanbiki.html#character]official site[/url]]
translation:
原本看似永远的平静，瞬间被打破！布拉滕哈特、杜沙托、弗洛勒斯三个同盟王国因当时军事实力最强的邪恶奥特西亚帝国的突然入侵而土崩瓦解！三个王国的公主，白羊座、夏琳、米蕾亚，以及其他王室成员都被俘虏了！

指挥军事入侵行动的帝国军官菲利克斯彻底阻止了被入侵土地上居民的反抗。他奉皇帝之命“玷污”王国的象征公主们，以阻止她们反抗，让她们发誓对帝国绝对忠诚！

菲利克斯等人精于侮辱女性之术的帝国士兵，那些背叛王国投向帝国一方的人，以及那些与帝国结下个人恩怨的人，都对白羊座和她的朋友们下了邪恶之手！

高贵的白羊座公主遭受了一系列的羞辱和国家罪行，践踏了她作为公主的骄傲和爱国情怀！对于自私的夏琳公主，我们将用严酷的惩罚来击退她的叛逆本性，不问任何问题！为了天真的仁慈的米蕾亚公主，我们玷污了她性感的身体，向她灌输背叛所爱之人的不道德快感！

他们成了自己欲望的发泄口，现在正与三位不同的公主陷入淫乱的疯狂之中！她们本应绝对不可侵犯的纯真被残酷地粉碎，她们作为人的纯真、荣誉、骄傲、尊严在性发育的游行中被玩弄！

很快，他们为了自己的人民、朋友和家人所说的话，就只剩下喘息声和猥亵的话语，他们为了自己的快乐而与自己的仇敌调情！

那是一只放弃理性，靠生殖本能生存的动物……没错，是一头母猪！
